headline: The coverage ruler is five inputs, not one. Freezing the assertion fixture froze the NUMERATOR only; the entity table, id_map, domain manifest and document corpus all move the denominator. All five are now pinned and the audit fails closed on an undeclared ruler change.
why_this_had_to_land_first: clean_ratio against a byte-identical pinned fixture was drivable from 0.1923 toward 1.0000 by editing files the fixture does not cover, so no extraction change was falsifiable. logs/phase_h5_coverage_round2.json closed with exactly this precondition.

provenance.round1_premise: the original miss-guided-extraction item came back BLOCKED_ON_PRECONDITION: baseline was 0.1923 not 0.4505 (SUPERSEDED), the instrument was gameable, and injecting gold into prompts for docs scored against that gold is answer-key leakage
provenance.round2: LAND_WIDENED with four pins; both reviewers returned MISFIRES
provenance.round3: builders died on the weekly agent limit; repaired by the orchestrator in the main loop from the reviewers' own required_change

objection_1_production_brick.defect: the fixture digest was enforced unconditionally, so run_audit(facts_json=None) — the production call — returned FAIL with clean_ratio null and 'fixture: file absent on disk'
objection_1_production_brick.fix: compare_ruler_pin(..., fixture_supplied) skips ONLY the fixture digest when no --facts-json was given; the other four still bind, and the report records fixture.supplied=false so the skip is visible rather than silent
objection_1_production_brick.red: run_audit(facts_json=None) -> status FAIL, clean_ratio null, ruler_problems ['fixture: file absent on disk']
objection_1_production_brick.green: same call -> ruler_verified true, ruler_problems [], quotable true

objection_2_unpinned_document_corpus.defect: derive_sample_n and the seed-0 sample are functions of collect_clean_docs, so the corpus is a denominator input. A round-2 reviewer parked 104 of 105 kanto .md files and reproduced the full exploit with all four then-pinned digests byte-identical.
objection_2_unpinned_document_corpus.fix: fifth pinned field `documents` = sha256 over the sorted (relpath, sha256) pairs plus n_docs; content-addressed, so it moves on edits, additions AND deletions
objection_2_unpinned_document_corpus.behavioral_red: under the four old pins a corpus-only edit scored verified=True, problems=[]
objection_2_unpinned_document_corpus.green: the same edit now reports 'documents: pinned … but live …' and verified=False
objection_2_unpinned_document_corpus.not_over_tight: a genuine added triple leaves the documents digest unchanged and still moves the ratio — the graph stays the thing under measurement and is deliberately unpinned

re_pin.why: landing the r2 `reasoning` stage changed configs/domains/pokemon-lore.yaml, which IS the pinned domain_manifest — the pin correctly caught my own commit
re_pin.notice: RE-PIN pokemon-lore/kanto: ruler changed on domain_manifest, documents — every coverage number after this belongs to a NEW series

baseline_measured_at_this_pin.status: FAIL — the coverage gap is real and is NOT closed by this work
baseline_measured_at_this_pin.note: 0.4505 is SUPERSEDED and must never be quoted in the same before/after as 0.1923

round3_review.verdict: CLASS_NOT_CLOSED x3 — zero SOUND, and all three reviewers found the SAME sixth input

the_sixth_input.why_it_is_a_denominator_input: overall_ratio = sum(unit hits)/sum(unit n) re-aggregates over whatever iter_editions yields, and iter_editions yields whatever the registry lists. Five pins covered the inputs of ONE unit; the registry decides how many units exist.
the_sixth_input.sharpest_reproduction: point the registry at a kanto_alias unit whose 15_structured is symlinked to kanto's and whose 10_clean holds 20 fixture-covered copies of the one document that scores 1/1 -> clean_ratio 1.0000, PASS, quotable true, while fixture_sha256, manifest_sha256, entity_rows 959, triple_rows 869 and id_map_entries 88 are identical to the pinned 0.1923 baseline. The pinned kanto.ruler.json is never even opened.
the_sixth_input.fix: editions_registry added to PINNED_RULER_FIELDS, with the resolved unit directory recorded alongside because a registry can RE-ADDRESS a unit without changing bytes

the_root_cause_under_it.what: ABSENCE of a pin was verification by default. unit_problems was computed only when a pin existed, so an unpinned unit produced no problems and was quotable — and the unit slug decides the pin filename, so renaming or adding a unit silently unpinned it rather than failing closed.
the_root_cause_under_it.fix: a run is quotable only if EVERY unit it aggregated was verified against a pin
the_root_cause_under_it.note: lands independently of the registry pin and is the more important of the two

still_not_done: miss-guided re-extraction still DEFERRED and still needs a held-out arm
the 0.6 gate is still FAILING at 0.1923 — this work makes the number trustworthy, it does not improve it
